Type: bench
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Nori Tufted Storage Bench, 58"L, Natural
Colors: Linen Stone
Materials: Hardwood
With a roomy interior and slow-close hinges, this upholstered storage bench is as functional as it is stylish. Lovely tufted fabric on the top offers a traditional look, giving your blankets and off-season clothes a stylish new home. 58"L x 18"W x 18"H 100 polyester fabric on a hardwood frame Traditional style with neutral color fabric, blending with transitional and modern décor A stylish piece for storing blankets or clothes; slow-close hinges for safe closure No assembly needed. Wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
